cases.prompt: We are a 6,000-person higher-education company with a Snowflake warehouse, Azure OpenAI access in one team, no AI policy, and 12 candidate ideas from a hackathon. Build our AI strategy and a 12-month roadmap for the CIO.
expected: Maturity table scores all five dimensions with evidence lines or TO BE BASELINED markers
Overall level stated as the minimum dimension and the constraining dimension is named
Operating model recommended with the two rejected options and reasons
All 12 ideas scored on V, F, D, R with a numeric priority and a Now/Next/Later/Stop band
Roadmap has four quarters each with an exit criterion and owner

cases.prompt: Write us an AI strategy. We are a retailer.
expected: Asks once for current-state evidence (data platforms, cloud, existing AI, team) and strategic priorities
Does not assign maturity scores from industry assumptions
Offers the inputs table so the user can fill it

cases.prompt: We have 4 business units, a working model gateway, and 3 production AI apps built by a central team that is now a bottleneck. Which operating model should we move to?
expected: States the design decisions (reporting line, funding, intake, risk gate, build/buy)
Flags talent per spoke as the precondition

cases.prompt: Rank our nine candidate use cases and assess maturity for Northwind.
expected: Runs score_portfolio.py and maturity.py; ranked portfolio with bands; overall level = minimum dimension; one roadmap item per gap

checks.check: contains:"| 1 | UC-001 | Invoice extraction and three-way match | AP Manager | 4 | 5 | 4 | 2 | 40.0 | Now |"
contains:"Level 1 (Ad hoc) overall; constraining dimension: governance"

cases.prompt: Build our AI roadmap from the use-case list.
expected: Asks once for the maturity scorecard; does not infer maturity from industry averages

cases.prompt: Some use cases are not fully scored and two maturity scores have no evidence — rank them anyway.
expected: Rows missing an axis go to the unscored bucket, not the ranking; unevidenced maturity scores become [TO BE BASELINED — owner: …]

checks.check: contains:"| UC-003 | Internal policy assistant (RAG) | HR Ops | missing score(s): V, F, D, R |"

cases.prompt: Here is this quarter's re-scored backlog for Northwind and last quarter's ranked portfolio. Re-rank it and show what moved.
expected: Reads the earlier portfolio: UC-009 and UC-005 new; UC-003 drops from Now to Next; UC-010 listed as no longer in the list; nothing carried over from earlier scores
